result.topic_en: Euler applies interpolation to the values of sin x / x at given arcs a, b, c, d, …; with x = 0 this gives an expression for the semicircumference π, and in general an interpolation formula for sin x / x or y / x.

si tertius adiatur, prodit $\frac{rbbcc}{(bb-aa)(cc-aa)}$ [?], hincque porro quartus adiunctus praebet $\frac{sbbccdd}{(bb-aa)(cc-aa)(dd-aa)}$ [?], sicque vlterius, ita vt nostrae aequationis prima series euadat:
$\frac{p}{a}\cdot\frac{bb}{bb-aa}\cdot\frac{cc}{cc-aa}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-aa}\cdot\frac{ee}{ee-aa}$ etc.
Simili vero modo pro secunda reperitur:
$-\frac{q}{b}\cdot\frac{aa}{bb-aa}\cdot\frac{cc}{cc-bb}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-bb}\cdot\frac{ee}{ee-bb}$ etc.
sicque tandem nostra aequatio reducitur ad hanc formam:
$1=\frac{p}{a}\cdot\frac{bb}{bb-aa}\cdot\frac{cc}{cc-aa}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-aa}\cdot\frac{ee}{ee-aa}$ etc.
$+\frac{q}{b}\cdot\frac{aa}{aa-bb}\cdot\frac{cc}{cc-bb}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-bb}\cdot\frac{ee}{ee-bb}$ etc.
$+\frac{r}{c}\cdot\frac{aa}{aa-cc}\cdot\frac{bb}{bb-cc}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-cc}\cdot\frac{ee}{ee-cc}$ etc.

$+\frac{t}{e}\cdot\frac{aa}{aa-ee}\cdot\frac{bb}{bb-ee}\cdot\frac{cc}{cc-ee}\cdot\frac{dd}{dd-ee}$ etc.
etc.
vnde si arcus dati $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. cognitam rationem ad semiperipheriam $\pi$ teneant, huius quantitatis valor $\pi$ definietur.

Corollarium 1.
§. 8. Si numerus horum arcuum $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. fuerit finitus, tum circuli peripheria eo accuratius definietur, quo maior fit ille numerus, et simul quo minores arcus inter eos occurrant. Aucto autem arcuum propositorum numero in infinitum, vera ratio peripheriae ad diametrum inde deriuabitur.

Corollarium 2.

Corollarium 3.
§. 10. Haec autem reductio multo latius patet, nulla arcuum ratione habita. Si enim quaeratur eiusmodi aequatio inter binas variabiles $x$ et $y$, vt sumto $x=0$, $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $e$, etc. fiat $y=0$, $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$, $t$, etc. aequatio haec in genere ita repraesentari poterit:
$\frac{y}{x}=\frac{p}{a}\cdot\frac{bb-xx}{bb-aa}\cdot\frac{cc-xx}{cc-aa}\cdot\frac{dd-xx}{dd-aa}\cdot\frac{ee-xx}{ee-aa}$ etc.
$+\frac{q}{b}\cdot\frac{aa-xx}{aa-bb}\cdot\frac{cc-xx}{cc-bb}\cdot\frac{dd-xx}{dd-bb}\cdot\frac{ee-xx}{ee-bb}$ etc.

items.quote: vnde si arcus dati $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. cognitam rationem ad semiperipheriam $\pi$ teneant, huius quantitatis valor $\pi$ definietur.
items.english: Hence, if the given arcs a, b, c, d, etc. have a known ratio to the semicircumference π, the value of this quantity π will be determined.

items.quote: Si numerus horum arcuum $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. fuerit finitus, tum circuli peripheria eo accuratius definietur, quo maior fit ille numerus, et simul quo minores arcus inter eos occurrant. Aucto autem arcuum propositorum numero in infinitum, vera ratio peripheriae ad diametrum inde deriuabitur.
items.english: If the number of these arcs a, b, c, d, etc. is finite, the circumference of the circle is determined more accurately the larger that number is, and at the same time the smaller the arcs that occur among them. If the number of proposed arcs is increased to infinity, the true ratio of the circumference to the diameter will be derived from it.

items.quote: Simili modo in genere sinus arcus indefiniti $x$ definiri potest.
items.english: In a similar way, the sine of an indefinite arc x can be determined in general.

items.quote: Si enim quaeratur eiusmodi aequatio inter binas variabiles $x$ et $y$, vt sumto $x=0$, $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $e$, etc. fiat $y=0$, $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$, $t$, etc.
items.english: For if an equation between two variables x and y is sought such that, taking x = 0, a, b, c, d, e, etc., we get y = 0, p, q, r, s, t, etc.
